label: Bible Study
prompt: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love _____ one another.
verse: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
note: Freedom isn't a license — Paul says its best use is serving one another.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church _____ such as should be saved.
verse: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
note: The early church kept praising and growing — new believers added not yearly or weekly, but daily.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Noah began to be an _____, and he planted a vineyard:
verse: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
note: 'Husbandman' is the KJV's word for farmer — Noah stepped off the ark and went straight back to working the ground.

label: Deep Water
prompt: (Now the man Moses was very _____, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verse: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
note: A parenthesis in the middle of Miriam and Aaron's complaint: the man they criticized was the humblest on earth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: She hath done what she could: she is come _____ to anoint my body to the burying.
verse: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
note: Defending the woman with the costly ointment at Bethany: she anointed his body 'aforehand' for burial.
